source.citation: Nwankwoala, H.O., Osayande, A.D., Nwosu, C.H., Ugwu, S.A. (2022). Groundwater exploration using vertical electrical sounding techniques in parts of Etche Local Government Area of Rivers State, Nigeria. Global Journal of Engineering and Technology Advances, 11(01), 088-100.
source.note: Values transcribed directly from the paper's Tables 1-8 (per-station IPI2/ID Interpex-inverted layer results) and Table 9 (curve type summary).
source.known_source_inconsistency: Checked cumulative-depth arithmetic (depth[i] should equal depth[i-1] + thickness[i]) for every station. It holds for Opiro, Odufor, and layers 1-4 of Ndashi/Umuokom. It does NOT hold for: Egwi layer 4 depth (printed 37.25, arithmetic gives 44.25), Ulakwo layers 2-3 depths, Okehi layer 3 depth, Akpoku layer 2 depth, and the LAST layer's depth specifically for Ndashi and Umuokom (both off by roughly the same ~9-10m, suggesting a systematic issue in the source paper's table typesetting, not a one-off typo). Transcribed exactly as printed regardless - not silently corrected, since guessing at the 'right' number would be fabrication, not transcription.
